title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics enhancements and runbook linking
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Oncalls frequently ask for quick access to runbooks and diagnostics when SLO alerts fire. This PR enhances the incident-bot's on-call diagnostics flow to: 1) attach contextual runbook links to diagnostics suggestions, 2) add a compact summary view that surfaces top 3 remediation steps, and 3) include SLO/metric links and recent deploy metadata in the diagnostic payload. The change unifies runbook linking logic used in the slo-toolkit and incident-bot so both components surface the same canonical links.

What this PR does (single-string changelog-style description): - Adds runbook linking service (incident_bot.runbooks) and client integration used by oncall diagnostics; - Enhances diagnostics renderer to embed top-3 quick actions with direct runbook anchors; - Adds extra context to diagnostics payload: last successful deploy SHA, last 24h error rate trend, and SLO link; - Adds unit tests and integration test harness for runbook resolution; - Updates incident-bot templates and Slack message formatting to include compact quick-links and tooltip-style hints; - Adds migration docs and a short rollout plan (gradual flag-off by team).

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for runbook resolver
- [x] Integration test for diagnostics payload
- [x] E2E Slack formatting verification (staging)
- [x] Docs: runbook linking and rollout notes
- [x] Feature-flagged rollout

Testing notes: Ran oncall e2e suite against staging (incident-bot-staging) with representative alerts; manually validated Slack messages in #sre-oncall and confirmed runbook anchors navigate to correct runbook sections. Load test: synthetic alert storm (1000 alerts/min) to validate message throttling and caching of runbook lookups (cache hit rate ~98%).
